The password security practice described in the text is highly insecure. Using the same password for every account is a major risk because if one account is compromised, all other accounts using that same password are immediately vulnerable. Although Sarah changes the password monthly, this does not mitigate the risk of a single breach exposing all her accounts. Additionally, relying on a single password for multiple services makes it difficult to maintain strong, unique credentials for each platform, increasing the likelihood of weak or easily guessable passwords.

A group of crows is called a murder.
